{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained negative sentiment (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 values) and model overestimates.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if true outcome consistently exceeds model forecast in the last 5-7 days (indicating overconfidence or lag).",
    "If model spikes upward after a recent low, apply a 10-15% downward correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "When sentiment history includes a 0.50 or higher positive sentiment, increase forecast by 3-5% to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates >10% from 30-day moving average, adjust toward the average.",
    "For horizon >15 days, reduce forecast sensitivity to recent sentiment spikes — use 2-3 day sentiment smoothing before applying correction.",
    "If true outcome is consistently 5-10% below forecast, consider reducing forecast by 5-8% to avoid overestimating upward momentum.",
    "When sentiment history shows a 0.00 trend for 3+ consecutive days, apply a 2-5% downward bias to avoid false optimism."
  ]
}
